claude_proposed_widenings.name: ignore_hindering_surface
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The cloak's remaining omitted rider is a web-specific immunity/bypass. Existing condition, speed, and spell-access atoms do not express immunity to a named hindering surface or movement through that surface under altered movement-cost rules.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "You can't be caught in webs of any sort and can move through webs as if they were Difficult Terrain."
